en.headline: Observatory issues Strong Monsoon Signal for northerly winds
en.dek: The signal is in force from 4:45 a.m. with strong northerly winds expected and occasional gale-force gusts.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Strong Monsoon Signal at 4:45 a.m. on Friday. The signal remains in force.
The Observatory said strong winds with mean speeds exceeding 40 kilometres per hour are expected from the north, and gusts will occasionally reach gale force.
People who are not well sheltered from the north are advised to take precautions against strong gusty winds. Flower pots and other objects likely to be blown away should be taken indoors.
Those planning water sports activities or operations at sea should take special care against high winds and rough sea conditions. Conditions are particularly rough over the offshore waters.

zh.headline: 天文台發出強烈季候風信號 吹偏北強風
zh.dek: 信號於上午4時45分生效，預料平均風速每小時超過40公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。
body: 香港天文台於星期五上午4時45分發出強烈季候風信號，現正生效。
天文台表示，預料本港吹偏北強風，平均風速每小時超過四十公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。
市民如身在當風地方，會受到偏北風正面吹襲，應採取預防措施，以防強勁陣風。花盆及可能被風吹走的物件應搬入室內。
打算進行水上活動或海上作業的人士請特別小心，以防大風大浪。在離岸海域，風浪尤其大。
